read: Wednesday was quiet, with no sector-moving clinical or regulatory prints. The biggest item was financing, not science: Pfizer has lined up as much as $1.5bn from Blackstone to fund berobenatide (ex-Metsera) in return for milestones only. That takes cost out of one of the most expensive obesity Phase 3 programmes outside Lilly and Novo, and it is a template others may copy. Equities were risk-on (S&P 500 +1.3%, Nasdaq +1.6%) even though a hot October CPI left the market pricing roughly 90% odds of a December hike. Issuers took advantage: PepGen and Prime Medicine each raised $125m, and Rezera ($200m, with GSK anchoring) and Windward Bio test the IPO window this week. Private money still favours neuro (Neurosterix $105m for an M4 PAM; VectorY $83.5m), and China-sourced assets keep turning into US approvals (Merck KGaA's pimicotinib, licensed from Abbisko). The next binary is Summit's ivonescimab PDUFA on 14 November.

items.headline: Pfizer lines up as much as $1.5bn from Blackstone to fund obesity drug berobenatide (ex-Metsera)
items.detail: Blackstone pays in through 2028. In return it gets undisclosed milestones tied to US approval of monthly injectable berobenatide and to sales targets, with no product rights. Pfizer keeps control of 10 ongoing and planned Phase 3s. This is effectively synthetic-royalty financing against the up-to-$10bn Metsera buy, and it frees spending for the rest of the pipeline ahead of Pfizer's LOE wall. Shares were +0.2% after hours.

items.headline: Capricor closes up 26.5% as it cuts about 10% of staff ahead of the 22 November deramiocel PDUFA
items.detail: The cut, about 23 roles, came with Q3 results, and Capricor is slowing work outside deramiocel. FDA extended the review after Capricor narrowed the DMD label request to upper-limb function (the HOPE-3 primary); the AdComm had voted 9-3 against the cardiomyopathy claim. No new FDA signal was disclosed. BioSpace frames the decision as the first real test of FDA's rare-disease framework.

items.headline: PepGen launches a $125m follow-on after its DM1 data; stock +14% on Wednesday after nearly doubling on Tuesday
items.detail: The raise follows 46.5% mean splicing correction at 10 mg/kg in FREEDOM2-DM1, and the 12.5 mg/kg cohort reads out in 1H27. The window is paying for clean data immediately.

items.headline: Merck KGaA wins FDA approval for Pimjetmi (pimicotinib) in tenosynovial giant cell tumour
items.detail: Pimicotinib is a CSF-1R inhibitor in-licensed from China's Abbisko. The approval rests on Phase 3 MANEUVER (ORR benefit vs placebo at week 25). It enters against Ono's Romvimza and Daiichi Sankyo's Turalio. This is another China-originated asset reaching the US market through a European major. (Merck KGaA, not MSD.)

items.headline: Neurosterix raises a $105m Series B for M4 PAM NTX-253 in schizophrenia; ex-Karuna Andrew Miller joins as executive chair
items.detail: This is a bet on an M4-selective follow-on to Cobenfy from people who built Cobenfy, after AbbVie's emraclidine stumble. Investors are not disclosed in the accessible text.

items.headline: J&J files Caplyta (lumateperone) for bipolar I mania
items.detail: This adds another label to the Intra-Cellular franchise after September's Phase 3 win.

items.headline: AstraZeneca acquires vaccine partner Omniose (announced 10 November, terms undisclosed)
items.detail: The deal brings in Omniose's bioconjugation platform for bacterial conjugate vaccines; the two have been partners since January 2024.

items.headline: Beeline Medicines details Phase 2 lupus data for afimetoran, the oral TLR7/8 inhibitor it licensed from BMS
items.detail: BEELINE (n=248) hit SRI-4 at week 48 on all three doses (p<0.001), and Beeline is heading to pivotal studies.

items.headline: BrightGene's GLP-1/GIP dual agonist BGM0504 beats Ozempic head-to-head, per Endpoints
items.detail: Trial details are behind the paywall. It adds to the volume of Chinese incretins benchmarking against Novo.

items.headline: Flagship merges Valo Health and Montai Therapeutics
items.detail: Terms are undisclosed. The combined company pitches discovery driven by human-evidence data.

items.headline: Zealand 9M: petrelintide (Roche-partnered) Phase 3 underway; opex guidance narrowed
items.detail: The Phase 3 runs three trials with about 7,000 participants. Opex guidance moves to DKK 2.7-3.0bn (from 2.7-3.3bn), collaboration revenue guidance stays at DKK 4.5bn, and cash is DKK 13.5bn. Phase 2 ZYNERGY (petrelintide plus enicepatide) starts in Q4.

items.headline: Prime Medicine prices a $125m offering at $3.50 a share
items.detail: That is 35.7m shares, plus a 30-day option on 5.36m more.

items.headline: Abeona buys Phase 3-ready EoE drug ABO-801 from Ellodi and raises a $30m PIPE (Monday news missed earlier)
items.detail: Terms are $20m in stock, $30m on approval, up to $30m in sales milestones and low-to-mid-teens royalties. Zevaskyn Q3 revenue was $13.5m (+18% q/q).

items.headline: Harvard study backed by German insurers says MFN can backfire
items.detail: A 25% rise in German prices would add about $6.2bn to German spending and about $300m to US Medicaid. Lilly and Boehringer are cutting planned German investment and Roche has paused expansion. STAT separately reports companies seeking workarounds on ex-US launches.

items.headline: FDA warns Chinese suppliers of compounding APIs that refused its records requests
items.detail: This adds supply-chain pressure on compounders.

items.headline: UK science minister Chris McDonald to pharma: "I want your money"
items.detail: The government has raised medicines spending under the US tariff deal and wants drugmakers to reinvest in the UK, while a watchdog probes the deal's cost.

items.headline: VectorY raises a €74.5m ($83.5m) Series A extension for VTx-002, a TDP-43 vectorised antibody in ALS
items.detail: The money funds PIONEER-ALS, and Endpoints tags Lilly among the investors.

items.headline: Rezera (RZRA) IPO: $200m at $11-13 (16.7m shares), expected to price/list around 12 November
items.detail: Jefferies, TD and Cantor are running the deal, and GSK has indicated up to $25m. Rezera develops oral NLRP3 inhibitors (ruvonoflast; PAD Phase 3 in 1H27).
